emergence.summary: A single-locus MECP2 GAIN-of-dosage: a duplication spanning MECP2 (Xq28) roughly doubles MeCP2, and because MeCP2 is sharply dosage-sensitive, the MeCP2-dependent neuronal regulation program is OVER-driven -> that axis is driven UP. This is the EXACT OPPOSITE-direction read of Rett on the SAME cached MECP2 locus (Rett = LOF, axis DOWN, corrective = raise MeCP2; duplication = GOF, axis UP, corrective = lower MeCP2) -- one gene, both dosage directions, both under the firewall. There is no approved therapy; lowering MeCP2 toward normal (antisense) reverses phenotypes in duplication models and is the lead investigational direction, with a NARROW window (over-lowering tips toward the Rett-like loss). The gamma read is of the MECP2 locus switch structure. Magnitude [O].

grades.perturbation_direction: [F] forced by (role x mechanism); cited biology
grades.perturbation_magnitude: [O] OPEN -- how far the switch moves is runtime/Layer-2, not sequence-derivable

per_gene.note: A copy-number GAIN at Xq28 spanning MECP2 increases MeCP2 dosage; as a broadly-acting transcriptional regulator, EXCESS MeCP2 OVER-drives its program -> axis UP. This is the mirror of the Rett LOF read on the same locus. The promoter gamma reads the locus switch STRUCTURE only; the lesion here is a structural copy-number gain, and dosage/magnitude is [O]. CAUTION: dosage-sensitive in BOTH directions -- correction must respect a narrow window (over-lowering reproduces Rett-like loss).

falsifiers.claim: MECP2 duplication (over-driven program) raises the MeCP2-dosage axis (axis UP) -- the OPPOSITE of Rett on the same locus
falsifiers.falsifier: a MECP2 duplication that LOWERED MeCP2-dependent program output, or behaved like the LOF (Rett) direction, would refute the over-drive direction
falsifiers.measurable_by: MeCP2 level and MeCP2-target program output by copy number (duplication vs normal vs null)

falsifiers.claim: lowering MeCP2 toward normal (restrain) is the CORRECTIVE direction for the duplication
falsifiers.falsifier: if normalising MeCP2 downward WORSENED or failed to improve the duplication phenotype, the restrain-MECP2 lever sign is wrong
falsifiers.measurable_by: duplication-phenotype rescue vs MeCP2-lowering dose (with a window -- under-correction returns toward Rett-like loss)
